visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a bright pink zippered jacket, sits in a brightly lit indoor cafe environment. She holds a silver spoon topped with a piece of pink-frosted cake. She takes a bite and suddenly freezes with a shocked facial expression, bringing her left hand to her cheek as if reacting to something unexpected in the food. (2) The scene shifts to her seated at a different table, now eating a plate of curry rice with omurice and broccoli. A small cartoon chef graphic is overlaid on the right. A sudden insert shot shows the digital display of a white scale reading 52.9kg. Back at the table, she looks visibly worried and distressed while continuing to eat the curry. (3) The woman is now standing in a modern indoor hallway with light wood doors. She has changed into a white long-sleeved shirt and a gray pleated mini skirt. She steps onto a sleek white and silver electronic scale. A close-up focus shot captures her bare feet positioned on the scale's metallic sensor plates. (4) She reaches down to grasp a hidden handle on the scale and pulls it upward. The camera zooms in on the scale's circular black-and-white display which begins to scroll through various data points including body fat percentage and skeletal muscle mass. Numerous text overlays appear listing the device's technical capabilities. (5) The final sequence features several close-up beauty shots of the scale, highlighting its rounded corners, magnetic handle docking mechanism, and waterproof casing. A hand is seen pouring drops of water onto the surface to demonstrate its resistance. A large white text graphic appears at the end showing pricing and dates for a promotional event.

The female narrator's delivery remains consistent in pitch and speed, but the tone shifts slightly toward a more structured, informative style as she begins explaining the features of the body composition scale. The voice is well-enunciated and prominently placed in the center of the audio mix. (4) The narrator continues with a detailed list of health metrics and device specifications. The acoustic BGM maintains its energetic and positive mood until the very end, where the speaker concludes with a promotional offer. The master track is professionally balanced with high clarity.
